newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude bounces in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude bounces in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude bounced in late U.S. paper trading on Monday, traders said.
A full boat of June Brent changed hands at $18.38 a barrel, up four cents from the settlement of London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE).
Partial June Brent cargoes traded at $18.37 and $18.36 a barrel.
May/June Brent was dealt at a steady minus 19 cents a barrel.
June/July was stronger, trading twice at minus 11 and once at minus 10 cents. The spread traded earlier in the day at minus 13 cents.
